Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.render

Class PanelRenderer

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.render.PanelRenderer
public final class PanelRenderer extends Object
Shared card surface renderer. Paints shadow, gradient, border and optional restrained glow.

Centralizes rounded gradient fills, restrained offset shadows and outline glow. It uses child graphics state and does not reposition scene children; PanelObject supplies content padding.

  • Method Details

    • draw

      public static void draw(Graphics2D graphics, double x, double y, double w, double h, double radius, Color fill, Color bottom, Color border, double borderWidth, double glow, boolean shadow)
      Draws the visual content in the supplied local coordinate system.
      Parameters:
      graphics - caller graphics context, preserved where a child context is created
      x - local pixel x coordinate (mathematical units for plot inputs)
      y - local pixel y coordinate (mathematical units for plot inputs)
      w - canvas or shape width in pixels
      h - canvas or shape height in pixels
      radius - nonnegative rounded-corner diameter in pixels
      fill - fill colour or enabled fill mode
      bottom - lower gradient colour
      border - outline colour
      borderWidth - nonnegative outline thickness in local pixels
      glow - glow intensity, clamped to [0,1] when drawn
      shadow - whether to render the restrained card shadow
